digest.text: EU regulators are moving fast: Omnibus VIII applies from 1 May 2026 and a draft Omnibus IX would add benzophenone-1, benzophenone-2 and prostaglandin-like substances to the ban list.
The US approved bemotrizinol as a sunscreen active, its first new one in over two decades, effective 9 Aug 2026.
India's CDSCO restated that injectables are not cosmetics and that cosmetics cannot make treatment claims.
Estée Lauder and L'Oréal reported growth, while Coty described FY27 as a transition year after selling the Gucci licence.

items.headline: EU Omnibus Act VIII adds 18 CMR substances to restricted or prohibited lists
items.summary: Regulation (EU) 2026/78 was published 12 Jan 2026 and applies from 1 May 2026, moving newly classified CMR substances into Annex II.

items.headline: EU draft Omnibus IX would ban benzophenone-1, benzophenone-2 and prostaglandin-like substances
items.summary: Notified to the WTO on 8 Jul 2026. CMR-based bans start 1 Feb 2027; SCCS-based bans follow after 12 to 24 month transition periods.

items.headline: SCCS finds no prostaglandin analogue safe for eyelash and eyebrow growth cosmetics
items.summary: The 2025 opinion covered isopropyl cloprostenate, norbimatoprost and a third analogue; earlier work flagged eye-area effects at very low doses.

items.headline: FDA adds bemotrizinol to the OTC sunscreen monograph
items.summary: Final order effective 9 Aug 2026 allows up to 6% for ages 6 months and older. DSM holds 18 months of exclusivity.

items.headline: FDA targets Nov 2026 for formaldehyde and fragrance-allergen proposed rules
items.summary: The Unified Agenda released 3 Jul 2026 also dropped the talc testing and GMP rules. Agenda dates are targets and often slip.

items.headline: Canada phases in fragrance allergen disclosure
items.summary: From 12 Apr 2026, 24 allergens must be declared; from 1 Aug 2026 newly marketed products declare 81, above 0.01% rinse-off and 0.001% leave-on.

items.headline: India's CDSCO: injectables are not cosmetics and cosmetics cannot be used for treatment
items.summary: Public notice of 18 May 2026 (File COS-1211/2026) under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940 and Cosmetics Rules 2020; BIS publishes restricted ingredient lists.

items.headline: CDSCO reminds hair-colour makers to meet IS 4707 and IS 8481
items.summary: Circular of 10 Jun 2026 stresses compliance with the Cosmetics Rules 2020 and the named BIS standards.

items.headline: China consults on bringing cosmetic finished products into new-chemical registration
items.summary: Draft revision of MEE Order 12 opened 11 Jun 2026; separately, over 100 new cosmetic ingredients were filed in China in 2026.

items.headline: Indonesia's BPOM drafts broader pharmacovigilance rules for cosmetics
items.summary: Part of the June 2026 regional recap; adverse-event monitoring is spreading from drugs to cosmetics.

items.headline: Biotech and precision fermentation lead in-cosmetics Global 2026
items.summary: The Innovation Zone listed 233 ingredient launches; experts highlighted fermentation, encapsulation and supply-chain dependence.

items.headline: Lesaffre launches Innosya with three fermentation-derived pro-aging actives
items.summary: Skinosya Chondro, Salidroside and SAG target skin stress, elasticity and menopausal ageing; clinically tested and vegan.

items.headline: Croda introduces Matrixyl Neolide, an encapsulated peptide
items.summary: Designed for faster peptide release through improved encapsulation, one of Croda Beauty Active's main 2026 launches.

items.headline: L'Oréal H1 2026: sales €23.77bn, record 21.3% operating margin
items.summary: Like-for-like growth of 6.8% (6.5% adjusted); Professional Products and Dermatological Beauty grew fastest; SAPMENA-SSA grew 13.8%.

items.headline: Estée Lauder FY2026: return to growth, FY27 margin outlook raised
items.summary: Full-year organic sales +3%, fourth quarter +5%; FY27 adjusted operating margin guided to 12.7% to 13.5%.

items.headline: Coty FY2026: transition year, consumer beauty review due by end of 2026
items.summary: Q4 revenue $1.27bn with like-for-like sales down 1%; Gucci exit and leadership changes under the Coty.Curated plan.

items.headline: Coty sells the Gucci Beauty licence back to Kering for about $400 million
items.summary: $250m received at signing and $150m due by 30 Sep 2027; Coty keeps operating Gucci Beauty through at least 30 Jun 2027.

items.headline: L'Oréal closes Color Wow, signs Innovist and takes on Kering beauty brands
items.summary: Color Wow completed 30 Jun 2026; majority stake in India's Innovist agreed; Gucci licence confirmed.

items.headline: Global beauty and personal care to reach $826bn by 2029
items.summary: Euromonitor via Cosmoprof: $635.2bn in 2025, $678.3bn in 2026, about 7% annual growth; fragrance +9.2% and sun care +7.8% in 2026.
